note: Patterns that are removed, renamed or deprecated as of Astro 7. An answer matching a rule is rejected unless the example is a migration question AND the answer presents the API as old/removed. Compiled from the v5, v6 and v7 upgrade guides via the Astro docs MCP.

rules.why: Astro.glob() was removed in v6; use import.meta.glob() or content collections.
The hybrid output mode was removed in v5; static is the default and pages opt out with prerender = false.
<ViewTransitions /> was renamed <ClientRouter /> in v5.
Legacy content collections were removed in v6; the config lives in src/content.config.ts.
type: 'content' | 'data' belongs to removed legacy collections; v6+ collections use a loader.
Legacy entry helpers were removed with legacy content collections; use getEntry().
Entries no longer have a render() method; import render() from astro:content and call render(entry).
z from astro:content / astro:schema is deprecated in v6; import { z } from 'astro/zod'.
@astrojs/db was removed in v7; use node:sqlite, Drizzle ORM or another database library.
These experimental flags were removed in v7 (now stable or default); cache and routeRules are top-level config.
The Lit integration was removed in v5.
The Squoosh image service was removed in v5.
The prefetch() with option was removed in v6.
emitESMImage() was removed in v6.
The astro:ssr-manifest virtual module was removed in v6.
import.meta.env.ASSETS_PREFIX is deprecated in v6.
functionPerRoute is deprecated adapter config.
Import getContainerRenderer from '<integration>/container-renderer' in v7.
Astro v6+ requires Node.js 22 or later.
Astro 7 ships Vite 8.
Dynamic prerender values in routes were removed in v5; use the astro:route:setup hook.
